mentions.name: LLM-driven narrative game
mentions.description: An LLM-driven narrative game where the story advances through generated progression options. It uses a memory hierarchy (Arc -> Scene -> Moment -> Line) that compacts the story to a constant amount of tokens per layer to keep context manageable, with ongoing work on tuning the amount of divergence in the generated story options.
mentions.problem: The main technical challenge is context compaction for long-running LLM narratives: how to compress the story to a constant token budget per layer, and how to get the right amount of divergence when generating story progression options.
mentions.source_excerpt: LLM-driven narrative game. Main technical issue is how go do compaction. I’ve devised a memory hierarchy that compacts the story to a constant amount of tokens per layer. Arc -> Scene -> Moment -> Line.
